en.title: ie
en.summary: This is the letter L324 from the vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: Sounds of ie
paragraphs: The letters ie have three sounds in English. The main sound is a vowel heard in (pie) /paɪ/, which means a baked dish with pastry. You also hear other vowel sounds in words with these two letters. Listen carefully to each word to pick the right sound.

sections.title: Saying the sounds
paragraphs: For the first sound, open your mouth wide. Glide your tongue up and forward toward your upper teeth. For the second sound, spread your lips wide and lift your tongue high and forward. For the third sound, keep your tongue high and relax your lips. Put a hand on your throat to feel the voice shake for all three.

sections.title: Reading the spelling
paragraphs: The letters make the sound in (pie) /paɪ/ at the end of short words. They also make this sound in (tie) /taɪ/. Inside borrowed words, the letters make the sound in (brief) /briːf/. You also hear that sound in (chief) /tʃiːf/. In a word like (sieve) /sɪv/, the letters make a short relaxed sound.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not read these letters as two separate sounds side by side. Say them together as one unit. In words like (tie) /taɪ/, glide smoothly from the open sound to the high sound. In words like (brief) /briːf/, hold the high sound steady. Do not add an extra beat between the two letters.
